## Data Preparation

```{r}
# Load normative-deviation outputs and retain baseline task sample information
load(file.path(outpath, "energy_deviation.RData"))

sub_task_info <- sub_test_info %>% 
  filter(eventname == baseline_event) %>% 
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, age, sex, biotype)

# Retain participants who passed nBack imaging QC
mri_y_qc_incl <- fread(file.path(demo_path, "imaging", "mri_y_qc_incl.csv"))

sub_qc_incl <- mri_y_qc_incl %>% 
  filter(eventname == baseline_event, imgincl_nback_include == 1) %>% 
  select(src_subject_id, eventname)

# Add task fMRI head motion
mri_y_qc_motion <- fread(file.path(demo_path, "imaging", "mri_y_qc_motion.csv"))

sub_qc_motion_incl <- mri_y_qc_motion %>% 
  filter(eventname == baseline_event) %>%
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, mean_fd = tfmri_nback_all_meanmotion)

sub_task_info <- sub_task_info %>%
  inner_join(sub_qc_incl, by = c("src_subject_id", "eventname")) %>%
  inner_join(sub_qc_motion_incl, by = c("src_subject_id", "eventname"))

td_task_info <- sub_task_info %>% filter(biotype == "td")
adhd_task_info <- sub_task_info %>% filter(biotype != "td")

cat("Baseline nBack QC-included sample:", nrow(sub_task_info), "participants\n")
cat("TD sample:", nrow(td_task_info), "participants\n")
cat("ADHD sample:", nrow(adhd_task_info), "participants\n")
print(table(sub_task_info$biotype))
```

```{r}
# Load nBack 2-back versus 0-back APARC/DK activation data and dictionary
mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk <- fread(file.path(demo_path, "imaging", "mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk.csv"))

mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk_dict <- fread(file.path(root_path, "data", "task_activation", "nBack", "mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk_dict.csv"))

mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk_dict <- mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk_dict %>%
  mutate(var_label = str_remove(var_label, "^Beta weight for nBack all 2 back versus 0 back contrast in APARC ROI "))

dsk_label <- mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk_dict$var_label
dsk_name <- mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk_dict$var_name

mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk <- mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk %>% 
  filter(eventname == baseline_event) %>% 
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, all_of(dsk_name))

# Merge activation values with sample information and replace variable names with DK labels
sub_activation_dsk <- sub_task_info %>%
  inner_join(mri_y_tfmr_nback_2bv0b_dsk, by = c("src_subject_id", "eventname")) %>%
  rename_with(~dsk_label[match(.x, dsk_name)], .cols = any_of(dsk_name))

td_activation_dsk <- sub_activation_dsk %>% filter(biotype == "td")
adhd_activation_dsk <- sub_activation_dsk %>% filter(biotype != "td")

cat("Activation data:", nrow(sub_activation_dsk), "participants x", length(dsk_label), "DK regions\n")
print(table(sub_activation_dsk$biotype))
```

## Case-control differences

```{r}
# Compare activation between ADHD biotypes after adjusting for age, sex and mean FD.
# beta and t indicate the adjusted difference of the non-reference biotype relative to biotype1.
run_covariate_group_comparison <- function(data, roi_vars) {
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(biotype = relevel(factor(biotype), ref = "biotype1"),
           sex = factor(sex),
           age = as.numeric(age),
           mean_fd = as.numeric(mean_fd))

  map_dfr(roi_vars, function(roi) {
    model_data <- data %>%
      select(all_of(c(roi, "biotype", "age", "sex", "mean_fd"))) %>%
      rename(activation = all_of(roi)) %>%
      drop_na()

    fit <- lm(activation ~ biotype + age + sex + mean_fd, data = model_data)
    fit_coef <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    group_coef <- grep("^biotype", rownames(fit_coef), value = TRUE)[1]

    tibble(beta = fit_coef[group_coef, "Estimate"],
           t = fit_coef[group_coef, "t value"],
           p = fit_coef[group_coef, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  })
}
```

```{r}
adhd_activation_dsk <- as.data.frame(adhd_activation_dsk)
activation_vars <- dsk_label

activation_dsk_stats <- run_covariate_group_comparison(adhd_activation_dsk, activation_vars) %>%
  mutate(roi_label = activation_vars, .before = beta) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
         p_sig = as.integer(p < 0.05),
         p_fdr_sig = as.integer(p_fdr < 0.05))

cat("ADHD biotype comparison completed for", nrow(activation_dsk_stats), "DK regions\n")
cat("Nominally significant regions:", sum(activation_dsk_stats$p_sig), "\n")
cat("FDR-significant regions:", sum(activation_dsk_stats$p_fdr_sig), "\n")

activation_dsk_stats %>%
  arrange(p) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "Top 10 DK activation differences between ADHD biotypes")
```

## Schaefer400 to DK68 mapping

Note: The DK labels in the csv dictionary and VertexWiseR are not in the same order. Therefore, the following code uses the VertexWiseR DK-70 order as the reference and then retains the 68 cortical DK regions.

```{r}
# Extract DK-70 labels from VertexWiseR and retain the 68 cortical labels used in the activation file
dk70_label <- ROImap_fs5@atlases[[1]]
dk70_label <- dk70_label[!is.na(dk70_label) & dk70_label != ""]

exclude_label <- setdiff(dk70_label, dsk_label)
dk68_keep <- dk70_label %in% dsk_label
dk68_label <- dk70_label[dk68_keep]

cat("DK-70 labels:", length(dk70_label), "\n")
cat("Excluded labels:", paste(exclude_label, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Retained DK-68 labels:", length(dk68_label), "\n")
stopifnot(length(dk68_label) == 68)
```

```{r}
# Build a DK68 x Schaefer400 spatial weight matrix.
# Each row indicates the proportion of DK vertices assigned to each Schaefer400 parcel.
I400 <- diag(400)

surf_I400 <- atlas_to_surf(I400, template = "fsaverage5")
dk70_from_schaefer400 <- surf_to_atlas(surf_I400, atlas = 1, mode = "mean")

W <- t(as.matrix(dk70_from_schaefer400))
W68 <- W[dk68_keep, , drop = FALSE]

rownames(W68) <- dk68_label
colnames(W68) <- paste0("Schaefer_", seq_len(400))

cat("Mapping matrix W68:", nrow(W68), "DK regions x", ncol(W68), "Schaefer parcels\n")
cat("Range of row sums:", paste(round(range(rowSums(W68)), 4), collapse = " to "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Project Schaefer400 deviation scores to DK68 using the spatial weight matrix
load(file.path(outpath, "energy_deviation.RData"))

deviation_schaefer400 <- as.matrix(W_scores_roi[, seq_len(400)])
storage.mode(deviation_schaefer400) <- "numeric"

deviation_dsk <- deviation_schaefer400 %*% t(W68)
colnames(deviation_dsk) <- dk68_label

cat("Schaefer400 deviation matrix:", nrow(deviation_schaefer400), "participants x", ncol(deviation_schaefer400), "parcels\n")
cat("DK68 deviation matrix:", nrow(deviation_dsk), "participants x", ncol(deviation_dsk), "regions\n")
```

```{r}
# Combine DK68 deviation scores with participant information and align with activation data
sub_deviation_dsk <- bind_cols(sub_test_info, as.data.frame(deviation_dsk)) %>% 
  filter(eventname == baseline_event) %>% 
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, age, sex, biotype, all_of(dk68_label)) %>% 
  filter(src_subject_id %in% sub_activation_dsk$src_subject_id) %>%
  arrange(match(src_subject_id, sub_activation_dsk$src_subject_id))

stopifnot(identical(sub_deviation_dsk$src_subject_id, sub_activation_dsk$src_subject_id))

td_deviation_dsk <- sub_deviation_dsk %>% filter(biotype == "td")
adhd_deviation_dsk <- sub_deviation_dsk %>% filter(biotype != "td")

cat("Deviation data aligned with activation data:", identical(sub_deviation_dsk$src_subject_id, sub_activation_dsk$src_subject_id), "\n")
cat("TD deviation sample:", nrow(td_deviation_dsk), "participants\n")
cat("ADHD deviation sample:", nrow(adhd_deviation_dsk), "participants\n")
```

# Deviation-Activation Correlation

## Control covariates in activation

```{r}
# Regress age, sex and mean FD from activation values and add the intercept back.
# This yields covariate-adjusted activation values on the original activation scale.
sub_activation_dsk_adj <- sub_activation_dsk
sub_activation_dsk_adj$sex <- as.factor(sub_activation_dsk_adj$sex)

for (roi in dk68_label) {
  model <- lm(sub_activation_dsk[[roi]] ~ age + sex + mean_fd, data = sub_activation_dsk_adj)
  sub_activation_dsk_adj[[roi]] <- resid(model) + coef(model)[1]
}

sub_activation_dsk_adj <- sub_activation_dsk_adj %>%
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, age, sex, mean_fd, biotype, all_of(dk68_label))

td_activation_dsk_adj <- sub_activation_dsk_adj %>% filter(biotype == "td")
adhd_activation_dsk_adj <- sub_activation_dsk_adj %>% filter(biotype != "td")

stopifnot(identical(sub_activation_dsk_adj$src_subject_id, sub_deviation_dsk$src_subject_id))
stopifnot(identical(td_activation_dsk_adj$src_subject_id, td_deviation_dsk$src_subject_id))
stopifnot(identical(adhd_activation_dsk_adj$src_subject_id, adhd_deviation_dsk$src_subject_id))

cat("Activation residualization completed for", length(dk68_label), "DK regions\n")
cat("Adjusted activation data:", nrow(sub_activation_dsk_adj), "participants x", length(dk68_label), "regions\n")
```

```{r}
# Run ROI-wise Spearman correlations between adjusted activation and deviation.
run_dsk_spearman <- function(activation_data, deviation_data, roi_vars, sample_label) {
  stopifnot(identical(activation_data$src_subject_id, deviation_data$src_subject_id))

  result <- map_dfr(roi_vars, function(roi) {
    tmp <- data.frame(activation = activation_data[[roi]], deviation = deviation_data[[roi]])
    tmp <- tmp[complete.cases(tmp), ]
    cor_test <- cor.test(tmp$activation, tmp$deviation, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    tibble(region = roi, n = nrow(tmp), r = unname(cor_test$estimate), p = cor_test$p.value)
  }) %>%
    mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
           p_sig = as.integer(p < 0.05),
           p_fdr_sig = as.integer(p_fdr < 0.05))

  cat("\nSpearman correlation:", sample_label, "\n")
  cat("Regions tested:", nrow(result), "\n")
  cat("N range:", paste(range(result$n), collapse = " to "), "\n")
  cat("Nominally significant regions:", sum(result$p_sig), "\n")
  cat("FDR-significant regions:", sum(result$p_fdr_sig), "\n")

  print(result %>% arrange(p) %>% slice_head(n = 10))
  return(result)
}

cor_result_dsk_sub <- run_dsk_spearman(sub_activation_dsk_adj, sub_deviation_dsk, dk68_label, "all participants")
cor_result_dsk_td <- run_dsk_spearman(td_activation_dsk_adj, td_deviation_dsk, dk68_label, "TD")
cor_result_dsk_adhd <- run_dsk_spearman(adhd_activation_dsk_adj, adhd_deviation_dsk, dk68_label, "ADHD")
```
